title: VXAce Moro's Poodle Demo OUT NOW!

posts.author: PachucoCadaver
posts.body:
(Demo)
​
​
​
GET THE DEMO HERE!
Moro's Poodle by Stagnelius
An RPG about stuff.
stagnelius.itch.io
​
"Everything in your life and in my life has lead up to this moment right now."
​
- Tig Ruxley
​
​
​
​
... And this is just a demo!
​
​
Join Gift and his friends in their journey to go home! All while uncovering a strange plot as more and more hidden truths about Gift's life rise to the surface.
3 hour+ Experience!
Strategic Battles!
!!!!
Strange Characters!
Boppin' Soundtrack!
A loving relationship between a goth-girl and a pile of slime!
... All of this and more in the Moro's Poodle Demo! So get it now!
​
This is a game that I've worked on sporadically for a pretty long time. I thought it was time that it became available to try out
I would like to add a BIG
Thank You
to the RPG Maker Web community for all the invaluable help that made it possible for this project to exist!
No one mentioned, no one forgotten.
If you do try it out I'm very open to feedback about improvements! Perhaps a summarizing description of your experience? I anticipate to have to make some changes in difficulty, and possibly rethink some skills and how they are used! (My ears are standing up)

posts.author: PachucoCadaver
posts.body:
Update v.1.0
The first update / patch for Moro's Poodle based on feedback from players!
It includes:
Updated text for better readability
Slight rework of the text system
General typo fixes
Genreal bug fixes
Updated intro scene with a new soundtrack
A crazy pastor who can hint you in the right direction
Some battle rebalances
Returning your skills in the Skill Tree is more affordable now!
More interactables!
Hope you enjoy it!

posts.author: PachucoCadaver
posts.body:
Update v.1.5
The second update / patch for Moro's Poodle based on feedback from players!
It includes:
Six new Skills for Gift! Aswell as a new Combo System for Gift's offensive skills!
Slimeman is now more dynamic! This entails:
- A new "Slime Constrictor" Skill! Now Slimeman can hold an enemy prisoner!
- A new "Slime Possession" Skill! Now you can possess your dead friends!
- Slimeman can now transfer certain Status effects through Squeezing his enemies!
Nettles has a new "Blood Clot" skill that damages all enemies who are pricked or bleeding!
A bunch new flavor text!
Some new tunes!
Genreal bug / typo fixes!
Rebalanced enemies and battles!
Hope you enjoy it!
